memories.content: The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They know the bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices to all members about the meeting and the proposed amendment.

Sunmark housing cooperative is a residential cooperative. Its bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members for any amendment to the pet policy to be valid. The special general meeting is scheduled for 2026-09-12. The meeting will be held in person at the cooperative's common hall. Members can attend in person or submit a proxy vote in advance. The board has sent out meeting notices and the proposed amendment text to all members.
